state:
Goal `core-random-and-1-more`: `Core\Random` and `Core\Random\Seeded` owe their feature proofs.
`Core\Random::bytes`, `::float` and `::int` are complete (`bun nv proofs --id` says so), with
figures in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`. `Core\Random` has its class card. `Core\Random\Seeded` is
still in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. `bytes` and `token` (both classes) now draw straight into
their result, one allocation each: `octets_from` and `hex_from` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs`,
pinned by `a_random_draw_allocates_its_result_once` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/allocation_policy.rs`.
So `token`'s bench can declare `allocations 1`. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Random::token`** — examples, hostile, perf, a `covers:` marker on `a_token_is_twice_its_byte_count_in_lower_case_hex`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:154`
**`Core\Random::pick`** — examples, hostile, perf, a `covers:` marker on `every_pick_is_an_element_of_the_subject`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:163`
**`Core\Random::sample`** — examples, hostile, perf, a `covers:` marker on `a_sample_is_that_many_distinct_entries`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:172`
**`Core\Random::shuffle`** — examples, hostile, perf, a `covers:` marker on `a_shuffle_keeps_every_element_and_renumbers`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:181`

backlog: `Core\Random\Seeded`'s seven members and its constructor, then its class card and its row in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`). `rule:core-api/reference-card`.
`bun nv proofs --id` reads help off the release binary, so a card just added reads as owed until `--nvs target/debug/nvs.exe` is passed. Owner: `tools/nv/cmd/proofs.ts`.
